newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - June 2.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - June 2.

text.p: -- PepsiCo Inc plans to reorganize its North American bottling operations by creating a separate unit, the Wall Street Journal reported. The reorganization, expected to be announced to employees today, might be a prelude to an eventual spinoff, the newspaper said.

-- Tobacco settlement talks may be delayed for at least a week by a dispute among the states over whether to give the tobacco industry full immunity from punitive damages, the Wall Street Journal reported,

-- Lockheed Martin International, part of military and aerospace company Lockheed Martin, said it was establishing a joint venture with Russia's Intersputnik International Organization of Space Communication to provide worldwide communication services via satellite.

-- Apple Computer Inc filed to sell 1.5 million shares owned by company co-founder Steven Jobs. In the filing, Apple said the shares were related to the computer-maker's acquisition of Jobs's firm Next Software.
